name: Fuel Route Optimizer — Django
postCreateCommand: python -m pip install -r requirements.txt && python manage.py migrate && python manage.py import_cities && python manage.py check
postAttachCommand: bash -lc 'if ! (echo > /dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/8000) >/dev/null 2>&1; then nohup python manage.py runserver 0.0.0.0:8000 --noreload > /tmp/fuel-route-django.log 2>&1 < /dev/null & fi'
